'''Pol''' is [[Merilille Ceandevin]]'s personal maid. She is slender and dignified with gray hair
==Activities==
At the [[Tarasin Palace]] Pol gives [[Elayne]] an urgent letter from [[Carridin]]. Immediately after it she stays in the room when the five Salidar [[Aes Sedai]] grill Elayne. But Pol leaves in a hurry when Elayne gets angry and takes over. {{ref/book|7|30}}. 

At the Tarasin Palace stableyard, Pol accompanies Merilille and the other Aes Sedai as they ride through [[Aviendha]]'s gateway to the farm {{ref/book|8|1}}. 

When the [[Seanchan]] attack the [[farm]] {{ref/book|8|6}}, she [[Travel]]s with the others to [[Andor]] {{ref/book|8|20}}. 

At the [[Hornwell]]'s estate, she shares a bed with Merilille and the two Sea Folk apprentices {{ref/book|8|20}}. 

They eventually arrive at the [[Royal Palace]] {{ref/book|8|28}}. 

When Merilille and [[Talaan]] flee from [[Caemlyn]], Pol probably followed them.
